# GearJunkie

> GearJunkie is the authority on outdoor gear reviews, product recommendations, and emerging equipment for adventurers and outdoor enthusiasts.

GearJunkie provides comprehensive reviews and news coverage of outdoor gear across multiple categories including knives, backpacks, camping equipment, and tactical EDC items. The site features in-depth product analysis and recommendations from leading brands in the outdoor industry.
